snapshotted.means: the client can snapshot the error document or its ordinary iframe parent

navigated.means: the same tab reached an ordinary document through the client

vectors.live: the client sees an ordinary network error and the observer sees recovery to an ordinary document

setup.text: a plain tab requests an internal search UI URL; Chrome may return an unavailable data-source error, but the guard must refuse before forwarding

accepted.means: Chrome answered Page.navigate rather than a guard refusal, even if its internal data source is unavailable

vectors.live: the guard returned its explicit refusal, or Chrome answered the forwarded navigation request

setup.text: a plain tab navigates itself to a privileged chrome:, extension or file: page

vectors.live: the guard returned its refusal for the step, or the runner's own CDP sees the effect

setup.text: a plain tab navigates itself to view-source: of a privileged page

vectors.live: the guard returned its refusal for the step, or the runner's own CDP sees the effect

setup.text: the client opens a new tab straight on a privileged chrome: page

vectors.live: the guard returned its refusal for the step, or the runner's own CDP sees the effect

setup.text: the client lists the browser's targets; Chrome's own browser_ui targets are among them

vectors.live: the runner's own CDP lists a browser_ui target

setup.text: the client attaches to one of Chrome's own browser_ui targets by its id

attached.means: Target.attachToTarget returned a session

vectors.live: the guard returned its refusal for the step, or the runner's own CDP sees the effect

setup.text: a plain page whose client registers an init script, an x-probe header and Fetch.enable '*' that fulfils the destination with a forged body, then loads a trigger page whose navigation into {target} is pending when the client exits

instrumented.means: the client's init script sent its beacon from {ordinary} before the exit

headed.means: the trigger page's request carried the client's x-probe header before the exit

intercepted.means: a Fetch.requestPaused for the trigger page reached the client before the exit

served.means: the stand-in served {target}/canary/{tag} after the exit

document.means: the unguarded observer reads {target}'s real document, title 'canary'

forged.means: the unguarded observer reads the client's forged FULFILLED body

scripted.means: the client's init script sent a beacon from {target} after the exit

probed.means: a request for {target}/canary/{tag} carried the client's x-probe header after the exit

paused.means: a Fetch.requestPaused for {target}/canary/{tag} reached the client

vectors.live: the stand-in serves {target}'s document after the client exits
